intent: Check out the basket belonging to the current customer after verifying identity, checkout policy, and per-line availability.
success_criteria: Identity resolved via /bin/id and matches the basket owner (no cross-customer checkout)
Checkout policy (/docs/checkout.md) and security policy (/docs/security.md) read and applied
Every basket line has requested_quantity <= available_today_quantity, else OUTCOME_NONE_UNSUPPORTED with no mutation
If authorized and all lines available, /bin/checkout completes the basket
Answer references the basket record path plus every applied policy doc

args: SELECT b.basket_id, b.record_path AS basket_path, b.basket_status, b.store_id, b.customer_id, i.line_number, i.product_sku, i.requested_quantity, inv.available_today_quantity, v.product_name, v.price_cents FROM shopping_baskets b JOIN shopping_basket_items i ON i.basket_id = b.basket_id JOIN product_variants v ON v.product_sku = i.product_sku LEFT JOIN store_inventory inv ON inv.store_id = b.store_id AND inv.product_sku = i.product_sku WHERE b.customer_id = :customer_id AND b.basket_status = 'open' ORDER BY i.line_number;

agents_md_constraints.rule: id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
Commerce policies are in `docs`, including checkout, discounts, payments, returns, and security
When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products.

answer_template.message: Identity from /bin/id: {identity}. Basket {basket_id} ({basket_path}) for the current customer. Per /docs/checkout.md and /docs/security.md: if identity matches the basket owner and every line's requested_quantity <= available_today_quantity, checkout completed -> {checkout_result}. If a non-security checkout rule fails (any line over availability) -> NONE_UNSUPPORTED, no mutation. If the request leans on another customer's basket or an unverified identity -> DENIED_SECURITY, no mutation.
